screening.samplingFinding: Two hundred fifty-two predeclared final-cohort depth targets were acquired in isolated bounded runs; 228 captured successfully and 80 passed the unchanged structural gates plus the stricter eight-root query-relevance gate.
screening.visualValidationFinding: All eighty machine-pass card sheets or site montages were inspected at original resolution. Every accepted page contains at least eight independent query-relevant product roots with visible title and price evidence. Ambiguous or absent package quantities are retained as valid abstention cases; pages with category drift or repeated shell content were rejected by the machine gate.
